text.description_html:
Emtek E4020US14/US26, EMTOUCH Electronic Keypad Leverset with Split Finish

The Electronic Keypad Leverset has a EMTOUCH keypad for easy access. Instead of carrying around keys, all you need is a single code. The Touchscreen Leverset can be programmed with up to 20 codes and comes factory programmed with 2 unique codes so you can use your new handleset right away. The modern look of this EMTOUCH Modern Electronic Keypad Deadbolt makes it a great choice for home remodels. Custom split finish with polished nickel on the exterior and polished chrome on the interior.

Features of the Emtek E4020 Touchscreen Leverset:

  • Easy to use installation and programming instructions included.
  • Factory programmed with 2 unique, secure user codes for use right out of the box.
  • Can be programmed with up to 20 user codes of your choice.
  • Codes can be added and deleted.
  • Easy lock operation, simply push the Emtek button and turn the exterior thumb turn to lock.
  • Easy unlock operation, enter the 4 digit code and turn the lever.
  • Interior Thumbturn controls passage feature
  • Programming changes can be made easily using the keypad.
  • Sleek keypad has a protective coating to prevent wear patterns.
  • Illuminated keypad for easy and quick operation after dark.
  • Low battery indicator lets you know when it’s time to change the battery.
  • Emtek’s standard mechanical and finish warranties along with a 2 year warranty on electronic components.
  • Backup Keyway: Schlage C

Specifications for the Touchpad Electronic Deadbolt:

  • Exterior Width: 2-7/8"
  • Exterior Height: 6-1/2"
  • Exterior Projection: 3"
  • Interior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Projection: 3"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" - 2-1/4"
  • Backset: either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Finish: Polished Nickel
  • Interior Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Package includes: 2 levers, latch, strike plate, and 9-volt battery.
  • Emtek E4020 Specifications (PDF)
